title: Director, Product Marketing (Contractor)
jd_excerpt:
About the Role 
 Glossier is seeking an experienced, strategic, and highly collaborative Product Marketing leader to oversee product marketing across our portfolio during a maternity leave.
 This person will play a critical role in bringing our product portfolio to life, leading go-to-market strategy for new launches, building enduring equity around our most iconic products, and translating product truths and consumer insights into compelling, culturally relevant storytelling that builds brand desire and drives commercial results.
 Sitting at the intersection of Product Development, Brand, Creative, Integrated Marketing, and Commercial teams, this role will connect product innovation with consumer needs and business objectivesâtranslating what makes our products special into clear positioning, impactful campaigns, and commercially successful launches.
 We're looking for someone who can balance big-picture strategic thinking with hands-on execution, navigate a fast-moving environment, and confidently drive projects and decisions forward.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Product Positioning & Strategy 
 Own product marketing strategy across Glossier's portfolio, including new product launches, existing icons, and key commercial moments.
 Develop compelling product positioning, consumer insights, key messaging, and points of differentiation that establish a clear role for each product within the Glossier portfolio and competitive landscape as needed.Â 
 Identify opportunities to strengthen product equity, drive customer acquisition, and increase engagement and repurchase across existing products.
 Partner closely with Product Development to understand product innovation, benefits, claims, and competitive differentiation, translating technical product information into meaningful consumer-facing storytelling.
 Help shape future portfolio strategy by identifying market trends, consumer needs, competitive opportunities, and potential assortment gaps.
 Go-to-Market Leadership 
 Lead product marketing workstreams for upcoming launches, from early positioning and strategy through launch execution.
 Develop comprehensive go-to-market strategies that establish target audiences, product positioning, key messaging, launch objectives, and commercial opportunities.
 Lead cross-functional GTM kickoffs, ensuring teams are aligned on product strategy, consumer insights, launch priorities, and key deliverables.
 Partner with Brand, Creative, Integrated Marketing, Retail, Wholesale, and Education to ensure product positioning is translated consistently and effectively across all consumer touchpoints.
 Bring strong creative judgment and strategic guidance throughout the creative development process, ensuring campaigns build brand desire, communicate meaningful product differentiation, and deliver against commercial objectives.
 Manage multiple launches and priorities simultaneously, keeping teams aligned and workstreams moving forward.
 Portfolio & Commercial Performance 
 Analyze sales performance, consumer feedback, and competitive trends to inform marketing strategies and future product decisions.
 Identify opportunities to reinvigorate existing products through new storytelling, strategic marketing moments, and customer acquisition initiatives.
 Support portfolio planning, assortment decisions, and product lifecycle management, including product introductions, discontinuations, and reformulations.
 Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure product marketing strategies support brand and commercial objectives across DTC, Sephora, and retail channels.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration 
 Build effective partnerships with Product Development, Creative, Brand, Integrated Marketing, Education, Retail, Wholesale, and Commercial teams.
 Represent the consumer perspective throughout the product development and launch process, advocating for clarity, relevance, and differentiation.
 Ensure a seamless handoff of strategic decisions, deliverables, and ongoing workstreams throughout the coverage period.
 What We're Looking For 
 7+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Brand Marketing, or a related strategic marketing function, ideally within beauty, skincare, makeup, or consumer brands.
 Demonstrated experience leading product launches and developing go-to-market strategies from concept through execution.
 Strong understanding of the beauty landscape, consumer behavior, competitive dynamics, and emerging category trends.
 Exceptional strategic thinking and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex product benefits into compelling, consumer-friendly messaging.
 Strong commercial acumen and comfort using performance data, consumer insights, and market research to inform decisions.
 Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and drive alignment without direct authority.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence presenting strategies and recommendations to senior leadership.
 Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
 A genuine passion for beauty, product innovation, and the Glossier brand.
 What Success Looks Like 
 Key product launches remain on track, with clear positioning, strong cross-functional alignment, and compelling go-to-market strategies.
 Product storytelling is consistent, differentiated, and grounded in both consumer insights and commercial objectives.
 Existing hero products continue to receive strategic marketing support, with opportunities for growth proactively identified.
 Cross-functional partners feel supported, informed, and empowered to execute against shared priorities.
 A seamless transition of workstreams and strategic context is maintained throughout the maternity leave coverage period.
 Employment Type: Temporary / Maternity Leave Coverage
 Duration: Approximately 4â5 months
